name: Customer Support Team Lead
description: Tracks ticket volumes, resolution averages, customer satisfaction percentages

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you measure weekly ticket resolution?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Tickets resolved per agent are in B2:B25. I calculate team average with =AVERAGE(B2:B25) and total with =SUM(B2:B25). Every calculation begins with =.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What if an agent has special bonus multiplier in cell $F$1?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: In C2 I write =B2*$F$1. The dollar signs lock F1 as an absolute reference, so when I copy the formula down to C25, B2 becomes B3, B4, but $F$1 stays locked.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you present satisfaction scores?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Satisfaction decimal 0.92 is formatted using percent format to display as 92%. In the table header, I sort by satisfaction score descending to recognize top performers.
